key.name: light-hour
key.summary: Hour when the light style starts

key.name: light-minute
key.summary: Minute when the light style starts

key.name: dark-hour
key.summary: Hour when the dark style starts

key.name: dark-minute
key.summary: Minute when the dark style starts

key.name: gtk3-dark-enabled
key.summary: Use a dark theme for GTK3 applications
key.description: Switch legacy GTK3 applications to Adwaita-dark while the dark style is active.

key.name: last-scheduled-switch
key.description: Unix time of the most recent scheduled switch that was applied. Used so that manual changes are kept until the next scheduled time, even across lock screens and restarts.

key.name: gtk3-dark-applied
key.summary: Whether the extension set the dark GTK3 theme

key.name: gtk3-previous-theme
key.description: The GTK3 theme that was active before the dark theme was applied. An empty string restores the system default.
